name: C071 Kẻ Đánh Dấu Yếu Điểm (Trượng Huyết Nhãn Điểm Yếu)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of a dark-fantasy Blood-Mark Oracle's crimson-eye targeting staff (Trượng Huyết Nhãn Điểm Yếu - C071 Kẻ Đánh Dấu Yếu Điểm) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete occult targeting staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (spiked blackened steel shaft) to top-right (an iron crosshair caliper ring framing a glaring crimson-gold reptilian Blood Eye crystal).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom spike to top crosshair eye crest with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use blackened obsidian steel, antique brass crosshair rings, and deep blood-red & fiery amber eye crystal).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Crimson-Eye Weakpoint Staff (Trượng Huyết Nhãn Điểm Yếu - C071 Kẻ Đánh Dấu Yếu Điểm) from the attached reference image.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the spiked iron crosshair staff with its glaring blood-eye crystal diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): a dark battlefield shadow-realm where glowing red-orange hunter target sigils and vampiric blood-threads lock onto unseen prey.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
